is.t: Slide 11 – Regional Risk / Control Assessment per control
Source: 1. Data-Control Country Matrix (control status of each country).

How it is calculated: number of COUNTRIES at each level for the control; score = UC×w1 + MC×w2 + IC×w3; % = score / (UC+MC+IC); result: >91% Under, ≥61% Moderate, else Insufficient (method of the original sheet 4.Final-AM Risk Assessment; weights in the yellow cells). Sorted lowest % first.

c.f: HYPERLINK("#'16 – Slide Data Index'!A1","« Slide Data Index")

is.t: Every number on this sheet is a formula – no value is typed by hand. Section A = what the slide shows; section B = calculation for all items; section C = formula used in each column.
